turns.reply:
`Console.print()` with no objects now respects `end`: it passes `("",)` into the render path instead of a `NewLine()`, so `print(end="")` writes nothing and the default still writes `"\n"`. I checked this with a quick script and ran the matching `print`/`end`/`empty` tests in `tests/test_console.py` (23 passed). The patch is submitted (one file, `rich/console.py`).

I did not act on the "Drop support for Python 3.8" part of the issue, since it doesn't affect the console output behaviour.
